blurb: Oars & Paddles Pavilion is available for rent with a maximum capacity of 50 people. The rental fee is $50 plus tax. The pavilion includes picnic tables and is located in Indian Harbour Beach.
extraNote: Security deposit must be paid in addition to rental fee and is refundable if no damage and facility is cleaned · Rental fee due 30 days prior to function · Obtain liability insurance for the day of your event · Pick up key and sign rental agreement on last working day before function · Return key on first working day following your function · Indian Harbour Beach Recreation Center Office for reservations and key pickup
